# sql.js 1.10.3 (vendored)

SQLite compiled to WebAssembly. Used **only** by `scripts/build-standalone.js` to build the
single-file browser demo (`dist/hyrdon-crm-demo.html`). The normal app (`npm start`) does not use it.
